releases.name: NHL 27
releases.summary: Experience all 32 NHL arenas rebuilt with each team’s energy, traditions, and identity, from goal songs, chants, and signature details to dynamic lighting, jumbotrons, and presentation that reacts to every matchup. A refreshed broadcast package gives every game a cleaner, more modern feel, with new graphics, updated camera work, and sharper on-screen storytelling before puck drop, between whistles, and during highlights.Create a league with friends, manage your roster, and compete head-to-head across a full online season with up to 32 human-controlled teams, flexible settings, schedules, and commissioner tools.Every NHL team plays with true identity through unique playbooks and tendencies, powered by ICE-Q and NHL EDGE data. Matchups feel distinct from puck drop to final horn, with real NHL systems you can study, equip, and use across modes. A new commentary team featuring ESPN play-by-play voice John Buccigross and former NHL goaltender Darren Pang brings fresh perspective, energy, and insight to every game. Updated play-by-play and analysis better capture the speed and emotion of hockey, with more natural reactions, improved flow, and deeper breakdowns that reflect what’s happening on the ice. Build your roster with deeper strategy through the introduction of authentic NHL coaches and playbooks. Coaches add new layers to team-building through unique line combination connections inspired by their real coaching history. [EA Sports]

releases.name: Shelf Work VR
releases.summary:
Shelf Work VR puts you right in the middle of a busy warehouse. Sort packages, manage deliveries, organize shelves, and keep everything moving before the work piles up.

Use your hands to grab, carry, sort, and place packages across different stations. Each delivery brings new items, new categories, and more pressure to keep the warehouse running smoothly.

From conveyor belts and delivery stations to storage shelves and package handling, every task is designed around simple and satisfying VR interactions.Work VR puts you right in the middle of a busy warehouse. Sort packages, manage deliveries, organize shelves, and keep everything moving before the work piles up.

Use your hands to grab, carry, sort, and place packages across different stations. Each delivery brings new items, new categories, and more pressure to keep the warehouse running smoothly.

From conveyor belts and delivery stations to storage shelves and package handling, every task is designed around simple and satisfying VR interactions.

releases.name: Dino Odyssey
releases.summary:
You have to complete this dangerous journey to survive extinction!

Extinction is not an option. The fate of your entire species rests in your claws!

In Dino Odyssey, you control a brave dinosaur on a dangerous journey to rescue the eggs of your kind, ensuring the survival and birth of new generations.

Run, jump, and use your wits to explore a world full of threats. Every egg collected is a breath of hope to save your species from disappearing forever!


Features:
* 50 different levels
* Over 20 unique mechanics
* 3 different biomes
* Handcrafted pixel art visuals and retro soundtrack

releases.name: Borderlands 4 - Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort
releases.summary: Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort, featuring the return of the legendary beastmaster from Borderlands 3.

releases.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero / The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition
releases.summary:
Lloyd Bannings returns to his hometown to follow his late brother's footsteps and join the Crossbell Police Department. However, he finds himself assigned to a ragtag new division called the Special Support Section, which performs odd jobs and helps people in need. 

But he and his new teammates slowly discover that their vibrant city hides a dark criminal underbelly...as well as a few terrible secrets.

releases.name: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
releases.summary:
Race beyond the orange track and jump into a Hot Wheels™-sized world with four islands to explore, each with its own vibe and challenges. Roam freely through a world full of adventures, smash obstacles, discover secret items, and take on epic activities.

BECOME THE RUSH MASTER
Each island is ruled by a Rush Master – the ultimate boss to defeat. Complete events to unlock their challenge, and beat them to claim their car and title. Once you've conquered all four, be crowned the one true Rush Master!

PICK YOUR RIDE
Master four unique vehicle types: all-out Versatiles, massive Titans, agile Drifters, and lightning-fast Speeders. Each offers a different way to race. Choose your favorite rides, build your Rush Squad, and get ready for any challenge. And don't stop there: show off by customizing your car, right down to the wheels!

A COLLECTION LIKE NO OTHER
Discover and collect 150+ vehicles through events, activities, and challenges. Unlock rare models, fill your garage, and hit the road with some of the most iconic Hot Wheels™ out there.

MAKE THE WORLD YOUR TRACK
With the new Track Builder, create next-level tracks using the world around you. Attach modules to the ground, build around buildings, or race above the city, weaving around towering skyscrapers.

ENDLESS FUN
Take on a variety of game modes including single-player, split-screen with up to four players, and online multiplayer with full cross-play*. Climb the leaderboards, prove your skills, and race your way to the top!

releases.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure
releases.summary:
Set just a few months after the events of Trails from Zero, a temporary peace has settled over Crossbell and the Special Support Section find themselves with newfound fame and status, thanks to their heroic actions.

However, the peace is soon broken with the rise of multiple organizations with ulterior motives. Framing these growing tensions is the increasing pressure from the Erebonian Empire and the Republic of Calvard, with Crossbell caught between them. 

With the safety of their home and the foundations of their team now on the line, Lloyd and his allies must gear themselves for the threats that loom ahead. Little do they know that Crossbell will soon become the stage for a climactic conflict that will determine its future...

releases.name: RIN: The Last Child
releases.summary:
Rin is a dark fairytale Metroidvania, in which you'll rediscover your magic, create spells and enchant them to create stronger and more effective spell variants. Explore vast mythical lands as you uncover secrets hidden behind the Aspects of Magic.

Play as Rin, a demigoddess, and obtain the power of aspects to fuel and develop your magic on your journey to save the world.

Rin is a true Metroidvania, in which exploration meets crafting. Thanks to the complex system of spell-crafting and enchanting no playthrough is the same.

releases.name: Drop Dead: The Cabin
releases.summary:
The Cabin is an intense and challenging game. Are you among the few that will survive? 

Gather supplies, arm up, and fight off waves of the walking dead that have escaped from an evil lab experiment. We expect you to die - a lot, each time you fall, you will earn XP to upgrade your character and weapons, making you stronger and bringing you one step closer to beating the game. Whether you play co-op or brave the horrors of hell solo - Fight with a blade, bat or a variety of guns, power up and become a pro monster slayer. 

Can you hold off the horde before they breach the Cabin? Do you have what it takes to survive?

releases.name: Dumb Ways to Build
releases.summary: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

releases.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
releases.summary:
The Crossbell State, located in western Zemlya--

Once the site of fierce territorial battles, it has since developed into one of the continent's leading trade and financial centers.

However, pressure from the Erebonian Empire and the Calvard Republic is steadily increasing. While corrupt officials from both sides remain locked in political disputes, the mafia and underground criminal organizations are preparing to start a war.

In the midst of all this chaos, the Crossbell Police Department has lost the trust of its people.

Among them are Lloyd Bannings, a rookie agent,
Elie MacDowell, granddaughter of Crossbell's mayor,
Tio Plato, a young sorcereress who wields an orbal staff,
and Randy Orlando, a former security guard.

The foursome are assigned to a new department, the Special Support Section, where they are left with no choice but to join forces in the face of adversity.

This is a story about four unlikely heroes fighting to overcome the walls defining their way of life.

releases.name: Hazard Pay
releases.summary:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process.

Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.

releases.name: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE
releases.summary:
BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

In BrokenLore: DON’T LIE, step into the fragile world of Junko, a young woman attempting to reconnect with Shinji and Hideo, two patients she once met in a rehabilitation center. Confined to her small apartment, she struggles between daily calls, fleeting moments of intimacy, and her own destructive compulsions. Her reliance on medication slowly unravels reality itself, leading her into warped visions and liminal spaces where nothing remains stable.

releases.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline
releases.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

releases.name: The Royal Writ
releases.summary: Sacrifice creates stories in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Watch your cards march to glory or permanent death as they battle toward the enemy. Each fallen hero becomes part of your kingdom's legend. Command wisely... some sacrifices are necessary.

releases.name: Detective VR
releases.summary:
DETECTIVE VR is a narrative investigation game for Meta Quest 3 & 3S: You can control time, collect clues and interview witnesses in Passthrough. The investigation takes place in your living room.

Explore unreliable testimonies and confront suspects to find out what happened!

A mix between ObraDinn/Immortality and Minority Report: An innovative way to tell a story in Mixed Reality.

releases.name: Picture Puzzle Girls - Slide & Match
releases.summary: Wild West Video Poker brings the fun of Vegas style 'Jacks or Better' video poker right to your fingertips. The app features actual Jacks or Better payout scale, upgrades, and unlock-able items. You can start earning daily interest, unlock higher stakes, and practice your way to a Video Poker Pro.
